# Shiny Spaces Cleaning

> Mobile cleaning business serving Heber City and the Heber Valley, Utah. Residential, commercial, and Airbnb/vacation-rental cleaning. No public street address or storefront.

Shiny Spaces Cleaning provides free, no-obligation estimates. Nothing is scheduled until the customer confirms scope and price. Request an estimate at /get-estimate, or contact by phone, text, or email.

## Contact

- Business name: Shiny Spaces Cleaning
- Phone / text: (626) 549-9782
- Email: hello@shinyspaces.info
- Website: https://shinyspaces.info/
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 7:00 AM–7:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Service area (Utah only): Heber City, Midway, Park City, Kamas, Hideout, Daniel, Charleston, and Wallsburg
- Location type: mobile service-area business. We come to the property. There is no street address or public storefront.
